claim: A retained private incremental target accelerates localized edits to the Native unit-test binary under this measured profile.

conditions.profile: test, Native codegen-units overridden to 16 in both arms
conditions.edit: Change a literal in a temporary test module compiled into the complete Native unit-test binary.

invalid_experiment.description: The original incremental arm set the force-list but left CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0. Telemetry showed no Native incremental route. Its timings are excluded from the comparison.

controls.unchanged_binary_with_wrong_expectation: exact test failed in each arm

decision: Keep this as evidence for qualifying Native unit-test incremental state. Do not extend the CI test-cache policy from this isolated profile alone.
limitations: This is a localized test-module edit, not an API, dependency, or broad production-source change.
The workspace CI graph enables additional features, including otel, and does not apply this Native test codegen-unit override.
The first seed builds have different cache warmth and are excluded from the rebuild comparison.
Two samples per arm do not establish a latency distribution.
Telemetry reports accumulate within each Kache session; aggregate hit rates are not per-edit cache hit rates.
Hosted merge groups do not retain the private Native incremental target used here. This is not a hosted CI speedup or a ten-minute SLO result.
